title: The Buddha's Path of Awakening
subtitle: A Comprehensive Illustrated Guide to Wisdom, Compassion, Ethics, Meditation, and Liberation
editorialCaveats: Early teachings are anchored primarily in the Pali Nikayas and their parallels in the Chinese Agamas.
Later chapters are explicitly identified as historical developments rather than presented as verbatim speech of the historical Buddha.
Translations of technical terms vary; the study uses multiple English renderings where they illuminate different facets.
The work is educational and contemplative and is not a substitute for medical or mental-health care.
The study paraphrases rather than reproduces long copyrighted translations.
guidingPrinciple: A teaching is understood when it reduces greed, hostility, confusion, and harm, and increases wisdom, compassion, integrity, and freedom.

strata.label: Early Buddhist orientation
strata.note: The study presents these chapters as teachings recurring centrally in early Buddhist sources, anchored primarily in the Pali Nikayas and Chinese Agama parallels.

strata.label: Later Buddhist historical developments
strata.note: Mahayana, Zen, and Vajrayana materials are labeled as later historical developments rather than verbatim speech of the historical Buddha.

strata.label: Integrated practice synthesis
strata.note: The book's own practical synthesis: a thirty-day practice, meditation instructions, daily rule of life, essential lists, glossary, and source map.
